scene: You land smoothly on the glass bridge where three whimsical transports wait.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a glowing glass sky-bridge. The player stands left-centre in her red jacket and white skates. On the far left hangs an open bamboo cable car. In the centre floats a moored red paper-lantern balloon. On the far right sits a noodle-cart monorail with open passenger sliding doors.
shown: A woven bamboo cable car with open doors idling on the far left.
A glowing paper-lantern hot air balloon tethered to the centre railing.
A steaming noodle-cart monorail train waiting by a sign on the far right.
